top_signals.title: ‘Quiet crisis’: Government expert panel convenes to tackle population decline
top_signals.summary: The panel discussed how to reverse the declining birthrate trend, how to build sustainable local communities and how to cope with labor shortages.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
